raw_posts.name: Wanaka Studio
raw_posts.tagline: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine
raw_posts.description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

raw_posts.name: Floot Payments
raw_posts.tagline: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude
raw_posts.description: Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

raw_posts.name: Prelulu
raw_posts.tagline: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story
raw_posts.description: Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

raw_posts.name: Render Sandboxes
raw_posts.description: Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

raw_posts.name: OpenMail
raw_posts.tagline: Give your AI agents an identity through email
raw_posts.description: Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

raw_posts.name: Orphex MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP
raw_posts.description: Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

raw_posts.name: OpusClip 4.0
raw_posts.tagline: Turn raw footage into ready-to-publish videos with AI
raw_posts.description: OpusClip 4.0 goes beyond AI clipping to edit raw footage into finished videos. Automatically clean up speech, add captions and B-roll, create multiple formats, apply saved editing styles, and generate animated hooks and motion graphics.

raw_posts.name: fileForensics
raw_posts.tagline: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.
raw_posts.description: fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

raw_posts.name: Mellow Kids
raw_posts.tagline: Personalized sleep and development app for parents
raw_posts.description: Most baby apps track what happened. Mellow Kids explains why, and what comes next. 🌙 Understand today: Log sleep, feeds and diapers easily. Mellow spots changes and tells you why. A routine to adjust, or a phase that will pass. 🔮 Prepare for tomorrow: A heads-up before sleep and development change, so you feel ready for each new stage. 🌱 The right guidance at the right time: Evidence based support, from short naps to separation anxiety and first tantrums.
